case_title: Immersive virtual reality training for excavation safety and hazard identification
evidence_statement: For the Manual group, knowledge scores decreased significantly from post-training to retention (p=0.030), illustrating the forgetting curve (Section 5.4.1).

node_name: Lack of hands-on operation in traditional training
case_title: Immersive virtual reality training for excavation safety and hazard identification
evidence_statement: Traditional training lacks hands-on operation; learn-by-doing is one of the most effective processes for acquiring knowledge (Section 6).

node_name: Retention measured only by knowledge test, not practical performance
case_title: Immersive virtual reality training for excavation safety and hazard identification
evidence_statement: The study assesses retention by measuring knowledge test scores; whether VR improves long-term practical performance is yet to be investigated (Section 6.1).
